# Buddhist Cosmology — จักรวาลในสายตาพุทธ

> A Thai-language long-form article about Buddhist cosmology as myth, ethical framework, and map of mind.

Canonical URL:
https://drsupakorn.github.io/buddhist-cosmology/

Author:
Dr. Supakorn Buasai

Primary themes:
- Buddhist cosmology
- Kamma and ethics
- Mental states and realms
- Impermanence
- Dependent origination
- Human existence as the optimal realm for awakening

Language:
Thai, with Pali and English terminology

Parent site:
https://drsupakorn.github.io/
